canonical_project: IREN Bundey Data Centre (Australia Renewable Data Centre Project)
notes: IREN (Nasdaq) first Australian campus: 1,300-acre site at Bundey (Regional Council of Goyder LGA), ~128 km north of Adelaide. 800MW hyperscale AI campus; high-voltage transmission connection agreement into utility substation signed Jun 2026 (stocktitan/pv-magazine); staged operations from 2028 (official page). ~$10bn per AFR/press. 800MW is ultimate campus capacity, not built IT load.
